product_metadata.title: etee Beeswax Food Wraps, Organic Biodegradable and Reusable Alternative to Plastic Wrap, Ziptop Bags and Storage Containers, Each Set Has 1 Small, 1 Medium, 1 Large Wrap, 6 Pack (18 Wraps)
features: Beeswax Food Wraps from etee are just as easy to use as plastic wraps, just with less trash. Completely reusable, they'll keep your food fresh and tasty for days and weeks at a time. They are heat sensitive, so to cook using a sous vide, microwave, and similar, it's best if you choose another option.

etee beeswax wraps are designed specifically for food storage. The waxed cotton is thin, pliable, and sticky, so they're ideal for wrapping sandwiches, making little snack pouches, and sealing open tops of containers like bowls, casserole dishes, or even plastic and glass storage ware that's lost their lids. All you have to do is unfold the wrap, stretch it around the food or container, and it will seal to itself, keeping food as safe as ziptop baggies.

Easy to clean! For good preservation, hand wash in cold water using an ethanol-free detergent. Allow to dry hanging like regular laundry. You can even towel dry and use damp if you need to pack a lunch right away. For long term storage, fold these sturdy wraps and put in a bin until they're needed again.

Each pack contains a variety of three wraps, one of each size: teal (7" x 8"), green (10" x 11"), and blue (12" x 14"). You can buy anywhere from 1 up to 12 packs, for a total of 36 individual alternatives to storage bags! Whether you're stashing a roll cake for tomorrow's bake sale, or covering a metal tray of loose fruit to freeze, this bundle of packaging goes the extra mile to keep your food fresh from freezer to fork.

etee wraps are BPA free, and made from a host of sustainable ingredients, such as coniferous tree resins, clove and cinnamon essential oils, and jojoba oil. Main materials are organic cotton, organic beeswax, and non-GMO soy wax. Fully compostable. Depending on the kind of food, there may be a transfer of color or dye. This is purely cosmetic and won't harm eaters in any way.
